fit_reason: Whole car, a 2010 Honda Accord Crosstour, listed by a private owner.
findings: Brake dust and grime on the rear wheel spokes and inside the wheel barrel
Light dirt and spotting on the white lower rear quarter panel above the wheel
Hazy, yellowed front headlight lenses visible in the side and front shots
Dust and light debris on the driver floor carpet and door sill area
Light wear and creasing on the tan leather driver seat bolster, which a cleaning and conditioning would freshen
Paint looks flat rather than glossy on the hood and side panels
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2010 Accord Crosstour. The interior looks well kept, but the headlights are a bit hazy and the wheels are carrying some brake dust, and a pre-sale detail would help it photograph much better. We're a local two-person detailing team that comes to you. Would you like a quote?
